articles.title: Oil rises on intensifying US-Iran hostilities, threat of Red Sea closure
articles.summary: Oil prices surged as renewed US-Iran hostilities intensified across the Gulf, breaking a fragile truce. This escalated conflict significantly disrupted oil flows through the crucial Strait of Hormuz, a vital maritime choke point for global energy supplies. The rising tensions highlight the profound impact of geopolitical instability on international trade routes and energy markets.

articles.title: Reliance Jio's 1,600-LEO satellite plan gets IN-SPACe technical nod, moves closer to India's first homegrown constellation
articles.summary: India's space regulator, IN-SPACe, has approved Reliance Jio's proposal to deploy approximately 1,600 Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites. The project is deemed 'technically sound' and comparable to global systems like Starlink. This marks a significant step for India's private sector in advanced satellite technology, enhancing national connectivity and boosting India's role in the global space internet market.

articles.title: Canadian Transportation Agency approves Lac-Mégantic, Que., rail bypass
articles.summary: The Canadian Transportation Agency has approved the construction of a long-awaited railway bypass in Lac-Mégantic, Quebec. This decision comes 13 years after a tragic rail disaster killed 47 people and devastated the town's downtown core. The bypass aims to enhance safety, prevent future incidents, and is a significant step in the community's recovery and infrastructure development, addressing a critical need arising from the past tragedy.
